links.outcome: Model AUROC in external validation across 21 hospitals and three health systems
links.effect: Retrospective external validation AUROC 0.835 (95%CI 0.834, 0.835) vs NEWS 0.766 and MEWS 0.704; AUROC remained ≥0.80 across demographics, conditions, and prospective validation.
links.quote: eCART’s performance remained high (AUROC ≥0.80) across a range of patient demographics, clinical conditions, and during prospective validation.

links.outcome: eCART discrimination compared with MEWS and NEWS on same data
links.effect: eCART AUROC 0.835 (95%CI 0.834, 0.835) vs NEWS 0.766 (0.766, 0.767) and MEWS 0.704 (0.703, 0.704) in retrospective validation.
links.quote: In retrospective validation, eCART had the highest AUROC (0.835; 95%CI 0.834, 0.835), followed by NEWS (0.766 (95%CI 0.766, 0.767)), and MEWS (0.704 (95%CI 0.703, 0.704)).

screen.reason: Multicenter prospective external validation (live/prospective data collection across health systems) and subgroup analysis of a gradient boosted clinical deterioration model (eCARTv5) for FDA clearance, but it evaluates model performance rather than testing a specific implementation/governance guardrail.
